description: Source code implementing AEAD cipher operations in BoringSSL, including context management, encryption, decryption, and related utilities.

methods.name: EVP_AEAD_key_length

methods.name: EVP_AEAD_max_overhead
methods.description: Returns the maximum overhead size for the AEAD algorithm.

methods.name: EVP_AEAD_max_tag_len
methods.description: Returns the maximum tag length for the AEAD algorithm.
